g.text: Nonlinear Residual Evolution and Within-Step Reduction

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #6c757e

g.text: Start / last = first / last logged records in each step. R is the nonlinear solver's scaled residual measure.
Stopping rule: at least 2 iterations, then global OR step-relative normalized residual ≤ 10⁻¹⁰.
Steps 4 and 23 use one fewer iteration than the preceding step; tolerance is met, with no preconditioner rebuild.
A lower nonlinear residual indicates better satisfaction of the discretized nonlinear equations within that time step.

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6c757e

g.text: Residual magnitude is not a CFD solution-error estimate. The late plateau is observed, not a verified floating-point floor.
